topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out our apartment building is converting to condos. It’s a big change, and I keep thinking about all the little details that might shift. How will the new owners affect our quiet evenings? Will they follow the rules as closely as we do? I’m not sure where to start with all this. Maybe I should talk to some of the other tenants, see if anyone else has figured out what this means for us. It feels like everything is up in the air, and I can’t help but wonder what my next move should be.
